alex: Heads-up — release/1.12.x cutoff in ~3h. Two quick asks: (1) who owns the minor semver bump entry in the changelog? (2) any last-minute cherrypicks that need approval?

mia: I can take changelog ownership. planning to fold the doc PR now. will add the semver note.

sri: Thanks @mia. For cherrypicks — I have one tiny deps fix (libkv bump) that needs a 2-line commit to keep compat tests green.

jordan: Tagging in case anyone objects to the dep bump: @alex @mia — it's just patch-level and already smoke-tested locally.

alex: @sri please paste the cherry-pick command you'll use and the commit sha. also add the test results snippet here.

sri: Command: `git checkout release/1.12.x && git cherry-pick -x d4f8b2a`

Tests: `make smoke && ./scripts/run_minismoke.sh` -> all green locally (6m). Will push branch `hotfix/deps-libkv-2026-03-17` for review.

mia: I'll update CHANGES.md under "1.12.x (next)" with: "deps: bump libkv to 2.3.1 — fixes intermittent timeout on kv-write" 

jordan: devops-bot queued: deploy-checks will run once the cherrypick PR lands.

devops-bot: [automated] Release window reminder: cutoff at 2026-03-17T18:30Z. Canary jobs: 12/12 passed, integration: queued.

alex: If the PR is up in 20m and tests are green, I'm fine approving. No other late changes from my side.

sri: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/release/pull/7891 — includes test logs and `git show`. Requesting quick review from @alex and @mia.

mia: Reviewing now. will ping once merged.

jordan: Small ops note — if merge causes any new blue/green mismatch, we should be ready to rollback to `release/1.12.x@{2026-03-17T17:50Z}`. keep rollback plan in PR description.

alex: Agreed. @devops-bot can you ensure the rollout uses canary percentage 5% for the first 30m?

devops-bot: [automated] Canary rollout schedule set: 5% for 30m, auto-promote on no regressions.

mia: Merged the changelog and the PR. CI gated merge, all pipelines passed.

alex: Thanks team. Closing the loop — changelog owned by @mia, cherrypick merged, canary schedule set. I'll do a final sanity check 10m before cutoff. :thumbsup:

jordan: Nice and tidy. good call documenting rollback.

sri: Thanks — I'll watch the canary runs and report any anomalies in #eng-oncall.

mia: cheers.
